eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 9:57 AM on JUL 24, 2026 Effective until 5:57 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A SAFE Alert has been issued for Tucson Police Department. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Tucson Police Department is looking for Joshua David Garcia, last seen on foot wearing a light gray t-shirt and gray shorts near 33rd Street and Park Avenue in Tucson, Arizona. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
